name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
eligibility_notes: Small and marginal landholding farmer families. Eligibility is based on landholding, not income. Excludes institutional landholders and income-tax payers.
benefit: ₹6,000 per year in three instalments of ₹2,000

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
eligibility_notes: Families identified as deprived in the SECC 2011 database, plus occupational categories such as rag pickers and street vendors. Check eligibility via the PM-JAY portal.
benefit: Health cover of ₹5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation

name: National Scholarship Portal
eligibility_notes: Varies by scheme. Most central scholarships require family income below ₹2.5 lakh and minimum attendance or marks. Verify the specific scholarship on the portal.
benefit: Tuition and maintenance allowance depending on the specific scholarship

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Gramin)
eligibility_notes: Houseless families and those living in kutcha or dilapidated houses, identified through SECC 2011 and verified by the Gram Sabha.
benefit: Assistance for construction of a pucca house with basic amenities

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
eligibility_notes: Adult women from poor households without an existing LPG connection. Priority to SC/ST, PDS beneficiaries, and other deprived categories.
benefit: Free LPG connection with first refill and stove

name: Skill India Mission (PMKVY)
eligibility_notes: Open to youth seeking short-term skill training. No income ceiling. Age typically 15-45 depending on the course.
benefit: Free short-term skill training with certification and placement assistance

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (Shishu)
eligibility_notes: Non-farm micro or small enterprise seeking a loan up to ₹50,000 under the Shishu category. No income ceiling.
documents: Business plan or proof of activity

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
eligibility_notes: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including sharecroppers and tenant farmers with valid land records.
benefit: Crop insurance covering yield loss from natural calamities, pests and disease

name: Atal Pension Yojana
eligibility_notes: Indian citizens aged 18-40 with a savings bank account. Income-tax payers are not eligible.
benefit: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after age 60

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
eligibility_notes: Bank account holders aged 18-70. Auto-debit of ₹20 per year from the linked account.
benefit: Accidental death and disability cover of ₹2 lakh

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
eligibility_notes: Any Indian citizen aged 10 or above without an existing bank account.
benefit: Zero-balance bank account with RuPay card and overdraft facility

name: National Social Assistance Programme - Old Age Pension
eligibility_notes: Applicants aged 60 or above belonging to a below-poverty-line household as per state BPL lists. State top-ups vary.
benefit: Monthly pension, amount varies by state
